# 1 Lombard Street

> All-day brasserie and bar in a Grade II listed former banking hall beneath an Italian-designed glass cupola, directly opposite Bank station in the City of London. Open since 1998. Seasonal British cooking from Head Chef James Holden. Owner: Soren Jessen.

## Key facts
- Address: 1 Lombard Street, London EC3V 9AA (City of London), directly opposite Bank station (Central, Northern, Waterloo & City lines, DLR). Monument is a short walk; Cannon Street around five minutes.
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday 7am to 11pm; Saturday bottomless brunch 12pm to 5.30pm; Sunday lunch 12pm to 6pm.
- Reservations: https://www.sevenrooms.com/reservations/1lombardstreet or 020 7929 6611. Events: events@1lombardstreet.com. General: reception@1lombardstreet.com.
- Cuisine: modern British brasserie, with produce from named British suppliers (e.g. Peter Hannan salt-aged beef, Happy Egg Co. eggs, Neal's Yard cheeses). Vegetarian and vegan menu available.
- Saturday Bottomless Brunch: £75 per person, sittings 12pm to 2pm and 3.30pm to 5.30pm.
- Friday Steak Night: Hannan Meats butcher's cut steak, peppercorn and béarnaise sauce, bottomless fries, £27 per person.
- Sunday lunch: roasts £35 per person (children's roast £17.50), 12pm to 6pm.
- Private dining: 1776 (up to 50 seated, 80 standing; own bar, built-in TV with HDMI), The Lombard Club (up to 24 seated, 40 standing), semi-exclusive Brasserie (up to 30 seated, 50 standing). Available for breakfast 08:00 to 10:30, lunch 12:00 to 15:00, dinner 18:00 to 22:00.
- Exclusive hire: up to 150 seated, 100 seated with a dance floor, 300 standing; evening events 18:00 to midnight. Priced on minimum spend and room hire.
- Weddings: exclusive hire (up to 150 seated, 300 standing) or 1776 (up to 50 seated, 80 standing).
- Off-site catering: Goosebox (https://www.goosebox.co.uk/), born from the 1 Lombard Street kitchen.
